changelog: Add multi-profile support via WEBUNTIS_PROFILE/--profile with WEBUNTIS_<PROFILE>_* env vars. Improve docs.
summary: Read-only access to Untis/WebUntis student timetables. Use when you need to fetch or summarize a student's current schedule (today/this week/date range), upcoming lessons, rooms, teachers, or substitutions from a WebUntis instance.
